summary: MacKenzie Realty Capital filed an 8-K reporting fiscal-year 2026 results and disclosing that its Board temporarily suspended its Preferred Share Repurchase Program to preserve flexibility for strategic alternatives being presented by financial advisor Maxim Group LLC. The Board cited selling pressure on common stock from prior preferred-for-common exchanges as impairing potential transaction negotiations. No price, stake, or timeline was disclosed, and no transaction is assured. Investors should watch for any Maxim-brokered deal, resumption of preferred buybacks, and further dilution from exchange mechanics.
